audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of eight Solarion tabletop-game branch records, from the healer selection through both tower approaches, the skeleton fight, sewer, capsule room, and final door. Every narration line, embedded action choice, fantasy title, class, location and combat result was reviewed in sequence and against every reachable branch. Event commands, branch keys, actors, movement, timing, prior-choice conditions, response delimiters, placeholders, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Solarion branches are handled separately. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
